decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated the product feed specifically for standalone Bluetooth speakers with high performance-to-price ratios. I excluded accessories like cases and charging cables. My consideration set includes the highly popular Altec Lansing (prod_045), the reliable JBL Clip 3 (prod_002), two high-wattage options (Raymate and BOGASING), and the aesthetically pleasing INSMY Retro. I ultimately chose the Raymate (prod_153) because it offers a significant power output of 30W and IPX7 waterproofing at a very competitive $39.99 price point, supported by strong reviews highlighting its volume and sound quality.
